subject: french
title: Sartre and Engagement
welcome_lead: Sartre's Huis clos stages hell as 'other people'. His existentialism urges engagement and responsibility.
meta_desc: French HL Literature: Sartre, Huis clos, existentialism.
final_note: L'enfer, c'est les autres — and the dialogue is in French.

concepts.def: 1944 Sartre one-act play set in hell.
Hell is other people — the play's famous line.
Bad faith — Sartre's term for self-deception.
Commitment — Sartre's call to political action.
Existence precedes essence — Sartre's foundational claim.
Freedom — radical and inescapable for Sartre.

walkthroughs.body_html: Three characters trapped in a Second Empire salon. No mirrors, no sleep, no exit. The setting itself is the punishment.
Each torments the others by being needed and refusing. The triangle is the dramatic engine.
Sartre embeds existentialism in conflict. Each character's bad faith is exposed by the others' gaze.
